description: Convert a time between IANA time zones with DST awareness: local time, UTC offset, abbreviation and DST flag on both sides, the offset difference and day shift, and each zone's next DST/offset transition (when, which way, how much). Flags nonexistent (spring-forward gap) and ambiguous (fall-back) wall times. Accepts ISO 8601, HH:MM, epoch seconds/milliseconds or "now"; up to 10 target zones. Offline (PHP's bundled tz database). Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/timezone-convert

from_zone.description: IANA zone the input wall time is in (default UTC); also accepts fixed offsets like +05:30. Alias: from

time.description: ISO 8601 (2026-03-08T02:30:00, optional Z or +01:00), HH:MM (today), epoch seconds or milliseconds, or "now" (default)

to_zone.description: Target IANA zone, or a comma list of up to 10. Alias: to

name: timezone_convert
title: Timezone Convert
